## What you will learn

 - Species distribution models (SDMs)
 - R programming langauge (R)
 - Geographic information systems (GIS)
 - Generalized additive models (GAMs)

## Course structure

In the first \# days, etc.

## Learning objectives

- Theory behind SDM
- Run SDM independently
- Apply SDMs to real problems
- Maps

## Software needed

 - R
 - `codetools`
 - `terra`
 - `mgcv`

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("codetools", "terra", "mgcv"))
```

::: {.callout-note}
`terra` is still in active development and some functionalities change with newer releases.
:::
